items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: You know John Gorton, who is a wonderful altoist, we talk about this a lot.

ctx.x: “Fiddler on the Roof,” yeah. And there was another one like in the mid-50s, I can’t remember the title of it, I think he’s doing some Ellington pieces on there. And he’s playing in a very classical-like tone, but very expressive and very beautiful, it almost sounds like a cello sometimes. But he had to me just the consummate concept of alto saxophone, which for a lot of people who don’t know it’s like I always tell people it’s the easiest one to start on and the hardest one to master. The alto, playing it…
Yeah. He had such an electricity about him and his personality too. One of the few people who seemed comfortable talking with his audience and getting the music across from that standpoint.
